sets.title: Pick the Prefix
sets.description: Choose the correct prefixed motion verb for each context

items.prompt: Кошка _____ в дом через открытое окно. (The cat ran into the house through the open window.)
items.promptEnglish: The cat ran into the house through the open window.
items.explanation: В- means into: вбежала (ran into). The cat entered the house.

items.prompt: Гости _____ и мы остались одни. (The guests left and we were alone.)
items.promptEnglish: The guests left and we were alone.
items.explanation: У- means departure: ушли (left/departed). The guests went away.

items.prompt: Лодка медленно _____ к берегу. (The boat slowly approached the shore.)
items.promptEnglish: The boat slowly approached the shore.
items.explanation: Под- means approach: подплыла (swam/floated up to). Moving closer to the shore.

items.prompt: Машина _____ мимо нас на большой скорости. (The car drove past us at high speed.)
items.promptEnglish: The car drove past us at high speed.
items.explanation: Про- means past/through: проехала (drove past). The car went by without stopping.

items.prompt: Мы _____ реку по мосту. (We crossed the river over the bridge.)
items.promptEnglish: We crossed the river over the bridge.
items.explanation: Пере- means across: перешли (crossed). From one side to the other.

items.prompt: Она _____ от окна и села на диван. (She moved away from the window and sat on the sofa.)
items.promptEnglish: She moved away from the window and sat on the sofa.
items.explanation: От- means away from: отошла (moved away). She left the window area.

items.prompt: Туристы _____ всю площадь и вернулись к автобусу. (The tourists walked around the whole square and returned to the bus.)
items.promptEnglish: The tourists walked around the whole square and returned to the bus.
items.explanation: Об- means around: обошли (walked around the entire square).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ в магазин за хлебом. (He stopped by the store for bread - quick visit.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He stopped by the store for bread (brief visit, then left).
minimalPairs.explanation: За- means drop by briefly: зашёл (stopped in). В- (вошёл) just means entered, without the 'brief stop' meaning.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ в магазин и начал выбирать продукты. (He entered the store and started choosing products.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He entered the store and started shopping.
minimalPairs.explanation: В- means simply entered: вошёл. No implication of a brief stop, just the physical entry.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ из комнаты. (She walked out of the room.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She walked out of the room (exited).
minimalPairs.explanation: Вы- means out of (a space): вышла из комнаты. У- (ушла) means departed/left entirely.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ и больше не вернулась. (She left and never came back.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She left and never came back (departed for good).
minimalPairs.explanation: У- means departed (gone away): ушла. Emphasizes leaving, not just exiting a space.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Group prefixes by meaning and fill in correct forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Распределите приставки по значению и заполните формы

categorySorting.instruction: Sort by prefix meaning: Movement IN/OUT or ARRIVAL/DEPARTURE?

items.word: приехать в город (arrive in the city)
уехать в командировку (leave on a business trip)
влететь в окно (fly into the window)
вылететь из аэропорта (fly out of the airport)

blanks: Дети _____ через дорогу по зебре. (The children crossed the road at the crosswalk.)
Мы _____ лужу стороной. (We went around the puddle.)
Он _____ ко мне и тихо спросил. (He came up to me and asked quietly.)
Она _____ весь парк за два часа. (She walked through the whole park in two hours.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: пере- = across; об- = around; под- = approach; про- = through
hints: From one side of the road to the other. Which prefix?
Avoided the puddle by going around it. Which prefix?
Came closer to me. Which prefix?
Traversed the entire park. Which prefix?
explanations: Пере- = across: перешли (crossed over the road).
Об- = around: обошли (went around the obstacle).
Под- = approach: подошёл (came up to, approached).
Про- = through/past: прошла (walked through the entire park).

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix wrong prefixes and build sentences with motion verbs
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки в приставках и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.hint: You cross a road, not enter it.
errorCorrection.explanation: Crossing uses пере-: перешли дорогу. В- (вошли) means entering a space, not crossing.

errorCorrection.sentence: Он отошёл в комнату и закрыл дверь.
errorCorrection.hint: Moving INTO a room, not away from something.
errorCorrection.explanation: Entering a room uses в-: вошёл в комнату. От- means moving away, not entering.

errorCorrection.sentence: Такси прошло к ресторану и остановилось.
errorCorrection.hint: The taxi drove UP TO the restaurant, not PAST it.
errorCorrection.explanation: Approach by transport uses под-: подъехало к ресторану. Про- means passing by.

errorCorrection.sentence: Птицы пришли на юг на зиму.
errorCorrection.hint: Birds fly away (depart) south. They don't arrive on foot.
errorCorrection.explanation: Birds departing south: у- + лететь = улетели. При- (arrived) is wrong direction, and birds fly, not walk.

translation.hint: around = об- prefix; lake = озеро (accusative after обойти)

translation.english: The plane flew over the city.
translation.hint: flew over/through = пролетел; над городом = over the city (instrumental)

translation.english: I dropped by my friend's place on the way home.
translation.answer: Я зашёл к другу по дороге домой.
acceptableVariants: Я зашла к другу по дороге домой.
По дороге домой я зашёл к другу.
translation.hint: dropped by = зашёл (за- = brief stop); к другу = to a friend's place

items.prompt: Солнце _____ из-за туч. (The sun came out from behind the clouds.)
items.promptEnglish: The sun came out from behind the clouds.
items.hint: Out of (вы-): appeared from behind the clouds.
items.explanation: Вы- = out: вышло из-за туч. The sun emerged from behind the clouds.

items.prompt: Солнце _____ за горизонт. (The sun went behind the horizon / set.)
items.promptEnglish: The sun set (went behind the horizon).
items.explanation: За- = behind: зашло за горизонт. The sun went behind the horizon (set).

items.prompt: Корабль _____ из порта в открытое море. (The ship sailed out of the port into open sea.)
items.promptEnglish: The ship sailed out of the port into the open sea.
items.hint: Out of (вы-) a contained space (the port).
items.explanation: Вы- = out of: вышел из порта. The ship left the enclosed port area.

items.prompt: Альпинист _____ на вершину горы. (The climber ascended to the mountain peak.)
items.promptEnglish: The climber reached the top of the mountain.
items.explanation: Вз- = up: взошёл на вершину (ascended to the peak).

items.prompt: Пассажиры _____ с поезда на платформу. (The passengers got off the train onto the platform.)
items.promptEnglish: The passengers got off the train onto the platform.
items.explanation: С- = down/off: сошли с поезда (got off the train).

items.prompt: Мы _____ в незнакомый район и заблудились. (We wandered into an unfamiliar area and got lost.)
items.promptEnglish: We wandered into an unfamiliar area and got lost.
items.hint: За- can mean 'wandered into' or 'ended up somewhere by accident.'
items.explanation: За- here means unintended arrival: забрели (wandered into). A secondary meaning of за- with motion.

patternRecognition.sentence: подойти к, подъехать к, подплыть к, подбежать к
patternRecognition.question: What does the prefix под- express, and what preposition always follows?
options: Approach, always followed by к + dative
Departure, always followed by от + genitive
Entry, always followed by в + accusative
patternRecognition.answer: Approach, always followed by к + dative
patternRecognition.explanation: Под- means approach/come closer. It consistently pairs with к + dative: подойти к дому, подъехать к магазину.

patternRecognition.sentence: войти / выйти, приехать / уехать, подойти / отойти
patternRecognition.question: What pattern do these pairs show?
options: Each pair uses the same base verb with opposite prefixes
Each pair shows imperfective vs perfective
Each pair shows different verb bases with the same prefix
patternRecognition.answer: Each pair uses the same base verb with opposite prefixes
patternRecognition.explanation: Prefixes form directional opposites: в-/вы- (in/out), при-/у- (arrive/depart), под-/от- (toward/away).

patternRecognition.sentence: зайти за угол / зайти в магазин / зайти к другу
patternRecognition.question: Why does зайти have three different meanings here?
options: За- combines with different prepositions to create different meanings: behind, into (briefly), to someone's place
They are three different verbs that look the same
They all mean the same thing with different objects
patternRecognition.answer: За- combines with different prepositions to create different meanings: behind, into (briefly), to someone's place
patternRecognition.explanation: За- is versatile: за угол (behind the corner), в магазин (stopped by the store), к другу (dropped by a friend's). Context and preposition determine the meaning.

blanks: Мальчик _____ на дерево. (The boy climbed up the tree.)
Листья _____ с деревьев. (The leaves fell from the trees.)
Корабль _____ вокруг острова. (The ship sailed around the island.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: за- = up onto; с- = down from; об- = around
hints: Upward onto the tree. Which prefix?
Downward from the trees. Which prefix?
Circular path around the island. Which prefix?
explanations: С- (down/off): слетели с деревьев (fell off the trees).
Об- (around): обошёл вокруг острова (went around the island).
